module_summary: Dual-clock simple dual-port RAM: register array written on wclk when wenc, registered read into rdata on rclk when renc.

anchors.name: RAM_MEM
anchors.why: Memory array written from wdata at waddr; read into rdata.

anchors.name: rdata
anchors.why: Registered read data loaded from RAM_MEM[raddr] on rclk when renc.

anchors.name: raddr
anchors.why: Read address selecting RAM_MEM word for rdata.

anchors.name: wenc
anchors.why: Write enable gating RAM_MEM update on wclk.

anchors.name: renc
anchors.why: Read enable gating rdata register load on rclk.

groups.name: ram_array
groups.description: Register-array storage shared by write and read clock domains.

groups.name: write_port
groups.description: wclk-domain write of wdata to RAM_MEM[waddr] under wenc.

groups.name: read_port
groups.description: rclk-domain registered read of RAM_MEM[raddr] under renc.
